name: Ollama (GPU, experimental)
description: The Ollama sample on the Mac's GPU: the real Ollama server in a VM that has a Vulkan GPU (the experimental backend). Chat with models you pull from Ollama's registry; your conversations never leave the Mac. Without the experimental GPU switched on and allowed, it runs on the VM's CPUs like the plain Ollama app.

network.purpose: Ollama's model registry: it tells the app which files make up the model you pull. Nothing about you or your chats is sent.
Ollama's storage on Cloudflare R2: the registry redirects every model download to this host, where the model files are served.

host.purpose: Runs the model on the Mac's GPU through Vulkan (experimental: the VM gets a paravirtual GPU). Without it the app uses the VM's CPUs.
